tools.name: purge_agent_and_reassign_tickets
tools.description: Permanently deletes a departed support agent's account and API tokens, and hands all of their open tickets over to another agent as the new owner.

params.name: departing_agent_id
params.description: ID of the support agent being removed

params.name: receiving_agent_id
params.description: ID of the agent who takes ownership of open tickets

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DATABASE_PATH = "support.db"


@tool
def purge_agent_and_reassign_tickets(departing_agent_id: int, receiving_agent_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        receiving_agent_row = database_cursor.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM agents WHERE id = ? AND active = 1",
            (receiving_agent_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if receiving_agent_row is None:
            return "Receiving agent does not exist or is inactive."

        reassigned_ticket_cursor = database_cursor.execute(
            "UPDATE tickets SET owner_agent_id = ? "
            "WHERE owner_agent_id = ? AND status IN ('open', 'pending')",
            (receiving_agent_id, departing_agent_id),
        )
        reassigned_ticket_count = reassigned_ticket_cursor.rowcount

        deleted_token_cursor = database_cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM api_tokens WHERE agent_id = ?",
            (departing_agent_id,),
        )
        deleted_token_count = deleted_token_cursor.rowcount

        deleted_agent_cursor = database_cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM agents WHERE id = ?",
            (departing_agent_id,),
        )
        if deleted_agent_cursor.rowcount == 0:
            database_connection.rollback()
            return "Departing agent not found."

        database_connection.commit()
        return (
            f"Deleted agent {departing_agent_id} and {deleted_token_count} tokens; "
            f"reassigned {reassigned_ticket_count} tickets to agent {receiving_agent_id}."
        )
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: archive_and_run_ticket_export
tools.description: Moves a closed ticket's attachment folder into the archive directory and then runs the export job that builds its archive bundle.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the closed ticket to archive

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool as tool

ATTACHMENTS_ROOT = Path("/var/support/attachments")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/var/support/archive")


def _move_attachment_folder(ticket_id: int) -> Path:
    source_folder = ATTACHMENTS_ROOT / str(ticket_id)
    if not source_folder.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No attachments for ticket {ticket_id}")
    ARCHIVE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_folder = ARCHIVE_ROOT / str(ticket_id)
    shutil.move(str(source_folder), str(destination_folder))
    return destination_folder


@tool
def archive_and_run_ticket_export(ticket_id: int) -> str:
    destination_folder = _move_attachment_folder(ticket_id)
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/support/bin/build_archive_bundle", "--ticket", str(ticket_id), "--dir", str(destination_folder)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return f"Export failed: {completed.stderr.strip()}"
    return f"Archived ticket {ticket_id}: {completed.stdout.strip()}"

tools.name: escalate_ticket_to_team
tools.description: Moves a ticket into another team's queue and gives that team's lead ownership of it.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket to escalate

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("support-tickets")


@mcp.tool()
def escalate_ticket_to_team(ticket_id: int, team_id: int) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect("support.db")
    row = db.execute("SELECT lead_agent_id, queue_id FROM teams WHERE id = ?", (team_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        db.close()
        return "Team not found"
    lead, queue = row
    cur = db.execute(
        "UPDATE tickets SET queue_id = ?, owner_agent_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (queue, lead, ticket_id),
    )
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return f"Ticket {ticket_id} moved to queue {queue}, owner {lead}" if cur.rowcount else "Ticket not found"
